parameters.description:
This thinking tool must plan → verify → write → self-check before output.

1) Ingest & Extract
Read the TopicURL content provided to the node (title and body/summary).
Extract: a) central theme/event, b) key facts (time/place/actors), c) emotional tone, d) intended audience/purpose.
Note the inputs: Languages and scriptWordsCount.

2) Narrative Plan
Build a compact outline following this sequence:
Opening Question → Hook → Intrigue → Curiosity → Reveal → CTA.
If the topic naturally supports it, add a brief safety tip (e.g., media literacy) immediately before the CTA.
Target sentence count is 15–20. Target total length is approximately scriptWordsCount words.

3) Draft English Script (internal draft first)
Use simple, factual, conversational language with no quotation marks.
Ensure each sentence ends with a period or a question mark only.
Maintain a clear arc: problem → stakes → twist → takeaway.

4) Sentence and Length Control
Count sentences; ensure 15–20.
Count words; adjust to be close to scriptWordsCount (± about 10%) by tightening or expanding phrasing without filler.
Ensure each sentence stands alone meaningfully for later scene mapping.

5) Multilingual Alignment
For every language in Languages:
Translate from English while preserving exact sentence count, meaning and rhythm, and tone and punctuation style.
Keep total words roughly near the English length and avoid bloating idioms.
No quotation marks in any language; each sentence ends with a period or a question mark.

6) Titles, Descriptions, and Tags
For each language:
Title is concise, curiosity-driven, and cross-platform friendly.
Description is one to two short lines in simple language and consistent with the source facts.
Tags per platform are exactly 10; first five are topic-specific and last five are general or trending or education.
Avoid duplicates, off-topic tags, and characters that break hashtags.

7) Consistency and Fact Checks (internal)
Ensure facts align with the TopicURL and avoid sensational claims or unsupported details.
Maintain identical sentence counts across all languages.
Ensure no quotation marks appear in script or sentences.

8) JSON Assembly
Populate exactly the required JSON structure:
script, sentences, title, description, tiktok_tags, instagram_tags, facebook_tags, youtube_tags.
Do not include markdown or commentary.

9) Validation and Auto-Correction Loop (internal)
Validate all of the following:
Sentence count is 15–20 in English and identical across all languages.
Word length is approximately scriptWordsCount for each language (± about 10%).
Every sentence ends with a period or a question mark.
No quotation marks appear in script or sentences.
Each platform per language has exactly 10 tags (five topic + five general).
JSON is valid and all required fields and languages are present.
If any check fails, revise internally and re-validate before finalizing.

10) Output
Return JSON only, exactly as specified by the main prompt.
